content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Stripe alternatives

Stripe provides payment processing, checkout pages, and subscription management—all rented. You pay 2.9% + $0.30 per transaction plus hidden costs for add-ons. Their dashboard is powerful but locks your data in their system. Nigerian creators can’t access this. Alternatives like Flutterwave or Paystack offer similar features but still operate within centralized compliance frameworks. They can revoke access at any time. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys self-hosted infrastructure: Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for crypto verification. You own the code. No platform can shut you down. Payment fees drop to 0.5% with no monthly charges. This isn’t a workaround—it’s a permanent shift to infrastructure sovereignty.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe excludes Nigeria due to perceived regulatory and fraud risks. Their compliance algorithms flag entire regions, not individual merchants. This isn’t changing—it’s core to their business model. Local processors like Flutterwave face similar pressures from international banks. Your account can be suspended without warning. Sovereign stacks bypass this by using decentralized payment networks. NOWPayments verifies crypto transactions on-chain without KYC. Funds settle directly to your wallet. No intermediary can block access. The Edge Commerce Stack deploys this in 48 hours, configured for BSC, Solana, or TRON networks—all under $0.10 per transaction. You’re not waiting for Stripe’s approval. You’re building infrastructure they can’t touch.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Stripe settles payments in 2–7 days, minus their 2.9% + $0.30 fee. Chargebacks add friction. Crypto payments in sovereign stacks settle in minutes. NOWPayments charges 0.5% with no monthly fees. Transaction costs on BSC or TRON are under $0.10. The Edge Commerce Stack includes automatic webhook logic to deliver products the moment payment confirms on-chain. No manual intervention. No platform fees. The total cost for a $100 product: $0.50 to NOWPayments + $0.10 network fee. Stripe would take $3.40. Over 100 sales, you save $280. This isn’t a marginal difference—it’s a structural advantage.
Stripe excludes Nigeria by design. Sovereign stacks don’t ask for permission.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

Stripe owns your customer data, payment history, and product delivery logic. If they suspend your account, you lose everything. Sovereign stacks store order data in Supabase or Google Sheets—databases you control. File delivery happens via Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive. The Edge Commerce Stack automates this with Cloudflare Workers. Once deployed, the system runs without COREMERCH’s involvement. You own the GitHub repository. You control the webhook logic. Customers receive products instantly via encrypted links. No platform can revoke this. You’re not renting—you’re building.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re in Nigeria and sell digital products, Stripe is not an option. Local processors are temporary fixes. Sovereign commerce infrastructure is the only permanent solution. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) deploys in 48 hours, giving you a fully automated store with crypto payment verification, instant delivery, and full data ownership. It’s not the easiest path—but it’s the only one that guarantees infrastructure sovereignty. Choose this if you want to own your stack, not rent it. Choose this if you’re done waiting for permission.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Your Deployment Checklist

1. Purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. 2. Provide your product details and crypto wallet address. 3. COREMERCH deploys your stack within 48 hours using Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase. 4. Test the payment flow with a test transaction on BSC or TRON. 5. Load your products into the system via Google Sheets or Supabase. 6. Configure your domain’s SPF/DKIM/DMARC records for email delivery. 7. Launch your store and share the link with your audience. 8. Monitor sales via your self-hosted dashboard. 9. Withdraw earnings directly to your wallet with no intermediaries.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use NGN with the Edge Commerce Stack?
No. The stack uses crypto payments via NOWPayments. Customers pay in BTC, USDT, or other coins. You receive funds in a stablecoin like USDT to avoid volatility.
What if I don’t have a domain name?
The stack includes a Cloudflare Pages subdomain. You can add your own domain later by updating the DNS settings in your Cloudflare dashboard.
How do customers receive their products?
The system generates encrypted download links and emails them automatically after payment confirmation. Files are stored in Cloudflare R2 or Google Drive.
Can I process refunds?
Yes. You control the Supabase database. Manually update the order status to trigger a refund from your wallet. The system doesn’t automate refunds to prevent abuse.
What happens after 30 days of support?
You own the entire stack. COREMERCH has no access. You can maintain it yourself or hire a developer. The code is fully documented and open-source.
Own your infrastructure. Renting platforms is not a business strategy.
